cards.text: Prune your trees so air and light reach the leaves. This helps leaves dry and slows leaf rust.
Ask the extension officer which treatment is approved for leaf rust and when to apply it. Use only what they advise.
When you replace trees, ask the extension officer about coffee varieties that resist leaf rust.
Prune and remove extra shoots on time. Open trees let air in and make leaf disease less likely.
Show the sick leaves to the extension officer before you buy any spray. Different leaf diseases need different action.
Pick all ripe berries and collect fallen berries. Remove berries with small holes. This slows the spread of the pest.
Prune your trees and remove extra shoots. Antestia bugs like thick leaves.
Ask the extension officer which treatment is approved for this pest. Do not spray before they confirm.
On steep land, make terraces or other lines that hold soil, so heavy rain does not wash the soil away.
After heavy rain, check your leaves for rust. Prune so that air can move through the trees.
Put mulch on the soil under your trees to keep water in. Keep the mulch away from the stem.
If you can water your trees, do it when the flower buds are ready and the rain has not come.
For replanting, ask your cooperative about coffee varieties that handle dry weather well.
Test your soil every 2 to 3 years. Decide what to buy only after you see the result.
Put lime on the soil only as the soil test report says. Ask the extension officer how much.
Do not buy phosphate fertiliser unless the soil test advises it. The wrong fertiliser can give big cherries with no beans.
Cutting old stems back to a stump lets new stems grow. It is advised after about 5 big harvests. Ask the extension officer first.
Do not stump trees during a dry spell. The trees need rain to grow new shoots.
Ask the extension officer about top-working or replanting old trees with disease-resistant coffee.
A very big harvest last season can make this season smaller. Part of this drop can be normal.
Do not buy spray or fertiliser only because the harvest is smaller. Wait for a soil test or advice from a person.
To protect next season, prune to open the trees. Test your soil, then choose fertiliser with the extension officer.
I cannot tell the cause yet. Ask the extension officer to visit and check the leaves, berries, soil and roots.
I am not sure. A person will help you. Send the SMS and wait for the answer before you spend money.

strings.Q01: Was your harvest last season unusually big?
strings.Q02: Did the flowers drop early, or fail to make fruit?
strings.Q03: Do you see this bug on your trees?
strings.Q04: Do some berries have small holes?
strings.Q05: Are most of your trees older than 20 years?
strings.Q06: Is the problem on the whole farm? Yes means the whole farm. No means only one area.
strings.Q07: Put 5 leaves from the WORST row in the bag.
strings.Q08: Now put 5 leaves from a GOOD row in the bag.
strings.Q09: Take a clear photo of each leaf on a dark cloth.
strings.Q10: Say your answer, or tap a button.
strings.C01: Do you agree to use this service? Say yes or no.
strings.C02: Can I share your farm record with your cooperative? Say yes or no.
strings.C03: Can we use your photos to improve the tool? Say yes or no.
strings.not_sure_title: Not sure — I am sending this to a person
strings.not_sure_body: I cannot give a safe answer. Send the SMS. An extension officer will reply. Do not buy anything yet.
strings.machine_drafted_notice: Machine-drafted translation — not checked by a native speaker
strings.cannot_read_body: I cannot read this leaf — it may not be coffee, or it may be something I do not know. Retake the photo or send it to a person.
strings.area_none: No area chosen yet. Rain and soil will not be checked.
strings.area_gps: Your location ({lat}, {lon}), inside the Kirinyaga map.
strings.area_failed: I could not get your location. Choose the demo area, or try again.
strings.area_outside: Your location is outside the Kirinyaga map I have data for. Choose the demo area.
strings.asof_note: Pick an earlier date to see what the rain was like then.
strings.asof_demo_btn: Demo: after the April 2026 heavy rains
strings.rain_caption: Heaviest day in the last 90 days: {mm} mm (satellite estimate for ~5 km, may differ on your slope)
strings.ev.contrast_low: The leaves from the worst row and the good row look about the same.
strings.ev.contrast:high: The worst-row leaves look much sicker than the good-row leaves.
strings.ev.leaf:rust_high: The worst-row leaves show signs of leaf rust.
strings.ev.leaf:rust_low: The leaves show little sign of leaf rust.
strings.ev.leaf:other_disease_high: The leaves have spots from another leaf disease.
strings.ev.leaf:other_disease_low: The leaves have few spots from other leaf diseases.
strings.ev.leaf:miner_high: The leaves show tunnels made by leaf miner insects.
strings.ev.rain_wet_90d: Heavy rain fell on 3 or more days in the last 90 days.
strings.ev.rain_very_wet_90d: Heavy rain fell on 6 or more days in the last 90 days.
strings.ev.rain_none_90d: There were no heavy rain days in the last 90 days.
strings.ev.flowering_dry_strong: The rain at flowering time was much lower than usual.
strings.ev.flowering_dry_mild: The rain at flowering time was a little lower than usual.
strings.ev.flowering_normal: The rain at flowering time was about normal.
strings.ev.ph_ok: The soil acidity is fine for coffee.
strings.ev.ph_high: The soil is not acidic. It may lock up some food for the trees.
strings.ev.lastSeasonHeavy_1: You said last season’s harvest was unusually big.
strings.ev.lastSeasonHeavy_0: You said last season’s harvest was not unusually big.
strings.ev.flowersDropped_1: You said the flowers dropped early or did not make fruit.
strings.ev.flowersDropped_0: You said the flowers did not drop early.
strings.ev.bugSeen_1: You said you see this bug on your trees.
strings.ev.bugSeen_0: You said you do not see this bug.
strings.ev.berryHoles_1: You said some berries have small holes.
strings.ev.berryHoles_0: You said the berries have no small holes.
strings.ev.treeAgeOver20_1: You said most trees are older than 20 years.
strings.ev.treeAgeOver20_0: You said most trees are younger than 20 years.
strings.ev.wholeFarm_1: You said the problem is on the whole farm.
strings.ev.wholeFarm_0: You said the problem is only in one area.
strings.nc.roots: I could not check the roots.
strings.nc.no_plot_data: I have no rain or soil data for your area.
strings.nc.leaf: I could not read the leaves.
strings.ab.photo_unusable: I could not use the leaf photos.
strings.ab.vision_low_conf: The photos were not clear enough for me to be sure.
strings.ab.top_two_close: Two causes look almost equally likely.
strings.ab.answers_contradict: Your answers and the leaf photos do not agree.
strings.ab.top_is_unknown: The most likely answer is something I do not know.
strings.ab.money_needs_high_conf: I am not sure enough to tell you to spend money.
